cohort: Over 1.9 million births in Sweden from 1997 to 2015
finding: Non-immune hydrops fetalis (NIHF) at birth is associated with obstetric complications and poor prognosis for the neonate, including a higher risk of preterm delivery, stillbirth, early neonatal death, and infant mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were reported more frequently in the NIHF group.
